pick.headline: Palestine National Council declares a Palestinian state
pick.summary: On 15 November 1988 the Palestine National Council, meeting in Algiers, proclaimed an independent State of Palestine.
pick.significance: The declaration's implicit acceptance of UN resolutions was a step towards the PLO's recognition of Israel, which opened a US dialogue with the PLO that December.
pick.fbis: An FBIS editorial report described Arafat formally proclaiming the "State of Palestine" at the final PNC session, broadcast live by Algiers television early on 15 November.

alternates.headline: Turkish Cypriots declare an independent state
alternates.summary: On 15 November 1983 the Turkish Cypriot assembly declared the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus.
alternates.significance: Only Turkey recognised it; the declaration hardened the division of Cyprus between two NATO allies' communities.
alternates.fbis: Delhi radio reported on 16 November that India deplored the unilateral declaration of independence by the Turkish-occupied part of Cyprus.
